nodes.n: Two days before the final. Tara's London flight is the same evening as the final. Nine o'clock.

nodes.t: The studio won't move the date. If I miss the flight, I lose the part.

choice.t: "Get on the plane. I'll win it for both of us."
"Stay. Watch me play. Just once more."
Charter her a later plane so she can see the final AND make London.

nodes.n: Final. Kolkata. Seventy thousand. The last over. Twelve to win. You're the captain and you're on strike.
In Box 4, a woman in your jersey has stopped pretending she doesn't understand the rules.
Box 4 is empty. Your phone, in the dressing room, has one message: "Boarding. Watching on my phone. HIT IT."

moment.title: 12 off 6
moment.desc: Final. Last over. Captain on strike. Twelve to win, and somewhere a woman watching on a phone or from Box 4.

nodes.n: The last ball sails over cover. You don't celebrate with the team. You run to Box 4.
Two runs short. You sit on the pitch. Sid sits next to you. Then the whole team does.

nodes.t: My plane leaves in four hours. I'll make it. Probably. Kiss me first.
I missed the flight. I missed the part. I don't care. I don't care at all.

msgs.t: I watched it in the plane toilet so I could scream.
The cabin crew are very worried about me.

nodes.n: Midnight. Vivaan's book launches. And one envelope arrives at the stadium hotel, addressed to you, in Sushma Kapoor's handwriting.

nodes.cliff: Sushma Kapoor wants to make one final deal.
